query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_payments, 
       SUM(amount) as total_amount,
       MIN(paymentDate) as earliest_payment,
       MAX(paymentDate) as latest_payment
FROM paymentRecords
WHERE paymentPeriod = 'Q1' AND YEAR(paymentDate) = 2026;
